title: SG-3.3 · Unit tests with mocked dependencies for the App flow
summary: App flow unit tests: object click opens the action menu, actions and dialogue choices update the story, and a remount restores saved state
description: Context: game/frontend/src/App.tsx composes IntroScreen, GameLayout, SceneView, ActionMenu and StoryPanel on top of useGame, which persists state through runtime/storage (readSaved/writeSaved). tests/app.test.tsx already renders the real stack with jsdom localStorage and covers the intro gate and basic clicks. Desired behavior: a dedicated App flow test file in which the storage dependency is replaced by an in-memory fake and the three flows are asserted. Expected result: green, fast unit tests proving the click-to-menu, action/choice-to-story and remount-restore flows. Why: guard the playable loop against regressions.
acceptance_criteria: Given the App is begun, when a hotspot is clicked, then the action menu for that object shows its description and action buttons
Given the action menu is open, when an action is chosen, then the story history shows the action's text
Given the opening dialogue, when a choice is clicked, then the dialogue closes and history records the choice text
Given a state saved through the mocked storage, when App is unmounted and remounted and Begin is clicked, then the saved story and open-door state are restored

in_scope: New App flow unit test file with a mocked runtime/storage module
Minimal accessibility seams in ActionMenu and StoryPanel needed by the tests

technical_constraints: Vitest + @testing-library/react in jsdom, as configured in game/frontend/vitest.config.ts
Dependencies mocked with vi.mock; no real network or browser
definition_of_done: All three flows covered by passing unit tests
